fields.label: Config ID
fields.help: The ID to use for the BitbucketServerConfig, which will become the final component of the BitbucketServerConfig's resource name.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: The location of this bitbucket server config.

fields.label: Peered Network
fields.help: The network to be used when reaching out to the Bitbucket Server instance.

fields.label: SSL Ca
fields.help: SSL certificate to use for requests to Bitbucket Server.

fields.label: Username
fields.help: Username of the account Cloud Build will use on Bitbucket Server.

fields.label: Connected Repositories
Project Key
fields.help: Identifier for the project storing the repository.
Connected Bitbucket Server repositories for this config.

fields.label: Secrets
Admin Access Token Version Name
fields.help: The resource name for the admin access token's secret version.

fields.label: Read Access Token Version Name
fields.help: The resource name for the read access token's secret version.
Secret Manager secrets needed by the config.
